title: Settings, remade so it fits every screen
caption: From your note: "rework the settings panel it is larger than my screen, cutting off. Remake to look great". The old panel was one long list, and on a big screen or a larger interface size it grew past the top and bottom of the window (the interface zoom multiplied its height limit). Now the settings sit in six sections: Text, Sound, Graphics, Controls, Voice & learning and Private. On a computer the sections are a rail on the left of a centred panel; on a phone they are a row of tabs under the header of a sheet that rises from the bottom. The header and close button stay put, the panel always fits the window at any interface size, and a section that doesn't fit scrolls inside it. Every setting works as before and keeps its saved value. Keys: Up and Down move between sections and rows, Left and Right change the choice, slider or switch you're on, PageUp and PageDown change section, Esc closes.
